package-private-no-exports.result: The package is private and has no exports map; this is negative evidence only, not proof that deployed source-path consumers do not exist.

feature-route-not-in-public-manifest.result: The wildcard dimensions route is absent from the deliberate feature public manifest; this does not prove absence of external source-path consumers.

no-tracked-dist-contract.result: No tracked dist declaration or bundle is available as an external API contract.

no-production-feature-route-consumer.result: The production AST graph has no dependency on the feature wildcard route; test fixtures are internal contract evidence only.

services-entry-is-public-layer-surface.result: Services API is a deliberate cross-layer entry, but entry-point exposure alone is not evidence of an external dimension consumer.

options.name: compatibility-preservation
options.action: Keep the legacy facade and feature barrel as source-path compatibility surfaces, with ownership moved from migration debt to a dedicated compatibility schema.

options.name: explicit-public-barrel
options.action: Replace the wildcard feature barrel with an explicit same-facade named value/type inventory while preserving all 89 values and 10 types. Do not redirect adapted or composed symbols to focused owners.
options.dependencyEffect: The feature barrel remains the sole facade importer. The explicit value/type split adds one type statement and one type importer to features → shared while reducing facade dependencies by zero.

options.name: retirement
options.action: Retire the source-path surfaces only after an explicit policy decision that they are unsupported, a complete declaration diff, and a release/semver note.
options.publicSurface: potentially breaking; no removal is authorized by this report

recommendation.rationale: Compatibility preservation keeps the already guarded wildcard route and all source-path contracts unchanged. Option B would create type-ratchet growth from 2 to 3 type statements and from 1 to 2 type importers without reducing a single facade dependency, so it adds Layer cost without architectural benefit.
